name: What preparations are needed before installing drywall in a garage?

mainEntity.name: What preparations are needed before installing drywall in a garage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before drywall installation begins, several key preparations are necessary to ensure a smooth and successful project. This includes ensuring all electrical wiring and plumbing are complete and inspected, as they will be concealed by the drywall. The framing must be structurally sound, plumb, and level, with any damaged studs or joists repaired or replaced. All existing debris should be removed, and the area cleared to provide ample working space. Lastly, if insulation is to be installed, it should be in place before the drywall sheets go up.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before garage drywall installation, ensure all electrical and plumbing are complete, framing is sound, the area is clear, and insulation is installed.
